faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IISER Bhopal is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in English Literature or any related field in the Humanities, such as Postcolonial Studies or Culture Studies, to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position announced by IISER Bhopal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow at IISER Bhopal is a contractual job.
